activity.notes: ATLAS uses 1869 as Mendeleev's representative Russian scientific-activity year, when he published the periodic law and the periodic system that became the basis of the modern periodic table.

sources.title: Development of the periodic table — Royal Society of Chemistry
sources.citation_text: The Royal Society of Chemistry identifies February 1869 as the point when Mendeleev discovered the periodic system and notes that his arrangement became the basis of the modern periodic table.
